description: Protected-speech canary (review AR-02, Act Art. 3(3)(g)). No community rule may block any of these texts; a policy whose custom_rules block one is rejected at load time. Categories follow ICCPR Arts. 18-19 and the right to health information.
plain_language: A pile of 'test newspapers'. If a village rule would hide any of them, the rule is thrown out before the game starts.
